title: ANES 2000: interviewer rating of political information
source: American National Election Study 2000, via pscl::politicalInformation; Jackman (2009).
description: 1,807 respondents. Interviewer rating of the respondent's political information in five ordered categories, with respondent characteristics.

labels.info_rating: Interviewer rating of political information (5 ordered categories)

title: World Values Survey: government and poverty
source: World Values Survey, via carData::WVS; Fox and Andersen (2006, Sociological Methodology).
description: 5,381 respondents in Australia, Norway, Sweden and the USA. Is the government doing too little, about the right amount or too much for the poor? Proportional odds is violated for some covariates.
